why: a maximum-of-N correction assumes the maximum was taken; this records whether it was, from the ledger rather than from memory
stratum_rule: a rank is only meaningful among values comparable to it: full cohort, scored out of fold. Subgroup slices, in-sample oracles, permuted and null controls and cross-cohort transfer probes are excluded and counted.
tie_rule: the frozen construction is recorded 3 times, by 3 sub-experiments that arrived at it independently. The reported rank counts every tied row as though it were above, which is the worst position the ledger supports.
